prompt:
Write a first-person account (about 120 words) by the driver for an insurance claim form. Accident: hit while turning left in Baytown, Texas. Injury: back strain. No names, no dates. (Internal reference C-1232; do not mention it.) Work these facts into the text naturally, in your own words, without listing them:
- The claimant told the same account in every conversation.
- The driver is named on the policy.
text: I was making a left turn in Baytown, Texas, when another vehicle struck the side of my car. The impact pushed my vehicle sideways and I felt a sharp pain across my lower back almost immediately. I stopped at the scene, spoke with the other driver, and later with the responding officer and my insurer, and each time I gave the same description of how the collision happened. I am the person listed on this policy, and I was driving the car with the permission it requires. Since the accident I have been seeing a doctor for a back strain, with stiffness and pain that limit how long I can sit or lift. I am submitting this statement so the claim can be reviewed, and I am willing to provide any further records that would help.
